description: $0.05 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one full tool-ergonomics audit report for one submitted MCP manifest: the categorical verdict band under the published criteria, per-section counted flags with evidence, per-tool rows, and a concrete ordered fix list. Submitted manifest content is processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the manifest (or its URL). Unlike the manifest-claim audit (V6 — are its claims true), this service grades whether a model can tell a manifest's tools apart and call them from what is written. It never runs the tools and never queries a model.

manifest.description: The MCP server's tools/list manifest document, in any accepted shape: { tools: [...] }, { result: { tools: [...] } }, or a bare array of tools. Mutually exclusive with url. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

url.description: The URL of a tools/list JSON document to fetch (read-only GET, 512 KB / 10 s caps) and grade as the manifest. Mutually exclusive with manifest.

name: ergonomics_audit
